#nigeria #abuja #shorts

lines.text: Lagos was Nigeria's capital for years. So why is it Abuja now?
By the 1970s, Lagos was overcrowded, and it sat at the edge of the country, in the south west.
In 1976, the government chose a new site, right in the centre of Nigeria, on land not tied to any one big ethnic group.
Abuja was planned from scratch. The Japanese architect Kenzo Tange designed its city centre.
On December twelfth, 1991, the capital officially moved.
But Lagos is still Nigeria's biggest city, and its business hub.
